source.notes: Explicit Phase 6 technical candidate intake: previous 14 independent expanded references plus nine non-HOLD Wave 3 references, using exact immutable source pins. No fallback, source merge, license signoff, anatomical, clinical, spatial registration or complete-body approval. P2 female large intestine and male prostate retain additional provenance review requirements. Male lung v1.4 and the three Wave 3 HOLD records remain excluded; gaps are retained.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Blood Vasculature, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Dataset, National Library of Medicine, adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein; asset metadata dates 2024-06-15. Registration with other datasets requires review.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Blood Vasculature, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Dataset, National Library of Medicine, adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein; asset metadata dates 2024-06-15. Source description unexpectedly says blood-vasculature-female, but title, file, object ID, and citation identify male. Resolve discrepancy with asset and reviewer before trusting anatomical variant.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Brain, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Allen brain reference atlas (Ding et al. 2016), adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Source states mirrored structures and rescaling to fit both Visible Human bodies; not an independent female brain scan. License changed at v1.3 to CC BY 4.0, v1.4 metadata dates 2024-06-15. Does not cover peripheral nerves.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Brain, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Allen brain reference atlas (Ding et al. 2016), adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Source states mirrored structures and rescaling to fit both Visible Human bodies; not an independent male brain scan. License changed at v1.3 to CC BY 4.0, v1.4 metadata dates 2024-06-15. Does not cover peripheral nerves.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Heart, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Dataset, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. A reference heart, not circulation simulation; reconcile overlapping vessels with vasculature assets.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Heart, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Male, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne. A reference heart, not circulation simulation; reconcile overlapping vessels with vasculature assets.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Liver, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Dataset, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Confirm lobar/vessel alignment with the separately sourced vasculature and GI models.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Liver, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Male, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Confirm lobar/vessel alignment with the separately sourced vasculature and GI models.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Lung, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Dataset, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Source states that in v1.3 larynx, trachea and main bronchi were removed, preserving lobes and intrapulmonary bronchi; those upper airway assets remain separate gaps.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Lung, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Male, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein; metadata date 2023-06-15. Source states that v1.3 removed the larynx, trachea and main bronchi, retaining lobes and intrapulmonary bronchi. The v1.3 source crosswalk has 71 records and no hyoid; v1.4 added VH_M_hyoid as its sole CSV row addition and failed the separate strict geometry audit. A v1.3 pass would only establish the stated older-source scope, not resolve the v1.4 defect or the hyoid gap. No silent substitution allowed.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Small Intestine, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Dataset, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Source includes position/measurement guides along a centerline, not all anatomy; source node spelling VH_F_jejenum must be preserved verbatim. Source-specific segment lengths are not population norms.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Small Intestine, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Male, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Source includes position/measurement guides along a centerline, not all anatomy; source node spelling VH_M_duodenum_horizonal must be preserved verbatim. Source-specific segment lengths are not population norms.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Spinal Cord, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Dataset, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Source specifies this subject had six lumbar vertebrae; this is reference-specific, not general anatomy. Crosswalk does not list the fifth sacral segment found in the male crosswalk. Preserve explicit gap and do not fabricate a match.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Spinal Cord, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Visible Human Male, National Library of Medicine; adapted by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. Source uses Frostell et al. 2016 during model preparation; spinal cord does not constitute peripheral nerve coverage.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Pelvis, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: Visible Human Dataset (NLM); crosswalk labels include bony pelvis, fused sacrum, coccyx, pubis, ilium, ischium and compact/trabecular bone tissue. No pelvic muscle atlas or microscopic morphology claim.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Pelvis, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: Visible Human Male (NLM); crosswalk labels include the same eight ontology IDs. No pelvic muscle atlas or microscopic morphology claim.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Large Intestine, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata explicitly describes approximate construction from the Visible Human Female pathway, fitted around adjacent organs, without direct imaging. Do not present as specimen scan or equal geometric fidelity to male.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Large Intestine, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: primarily colonoscopy-derived data credited to Arie Kaufman (Stony Brook University), generally aligned to Visible Human Male. Does not cover complete digestive tract.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Pancreas, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: Visible Human Dataset; v1.3 adjusted neck/body/tail proportions. Macroscopic organ regions only; no islet, endocrine cell or functional physiology representation inferred.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Pancreas, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: Visible Human Male; v1.3 adjusted neck/body/tail proportions. Macroscopic organ regions only; no islet, endocrine cell or functional physiology representation inferred.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Spleen, Female
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: Visible Human Dataset; crosswalk covers spleen and five labeled surfaces/hilum. Not a lymphatic network or immune cell atlas.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Spleen, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: Visible Human Male; crosswalk covers same six IDs. Not a lymphatic network or immune cell atlas.

sources.title: 3D Reference Organ for Prostate, Male
sources.provenanceNote: Source metadata: Visible Human Male, CC BY 4.0; crosswalk root label male reproductive system does not establish whole-system completeness. Scope includes prostate and a limited named associated duct/vesicle subset.

excludedSources.reason: Missing exact VH_M_hyoid node in pinned source GLB; no correction, alias, row removal or fallback.

Source metadata: Visible Human Dataset (NLM); v1.3 metadata says renal calyces and papillae were moved to ureter; CSV still lists renal papillae. Resolve metadata/geometry discrepancy before review. Left-only; not bilateral coverage.

Source metadata: Visible Human Male (NLM); v1.3 metadata says renal calyces and papillae were moved to ureter; CSV still lists renal papillae. Resolve metadata/geometry discrepancy before review. Left-only; not bilateral coverage.

Source metadata: Visible Human Dataset; latest pinned folder v1.2 but citation inside metadata says Uterus v1.1. Resolve reporting/version discrepancy before review. Does not cover all female reproductive organs.

openGaps.reason: Source variant provenance, male description typo, source mapping, unit/pose alignment and branch continuity require evidence.
Brain geometry alone does not cover peripheral nerves; separate assets, source rights and anatomical mapping remain required.
No GLB bytes, real geometry decode, measured bounds, anatomy review or clinical validation obtained. All four candidates require actual intake and identical release-quality review.

Urinary detail needs four separately pinned kidney reference objects (left/right x male/female) next; other GI organs, upper airway, lymphatic, endocrine, reproductive and other organ-system structures remain open. Source releases are independent and may overlap.

Heart and liver overlap vasculature; lung excludes separate larynx, trachea and main bronchi; small intestine may contain unmapped measurement guides. Do not confuse root/group nodes, markers or overlapping reference objects with standalone anatomy.

Spinal cord is central nervous system, not peripheral nerve coverage. Female crosswalk has a missing fifth sacral segment relative to male; record a gap, review source-specific variant, do not infer missing geometry.
No binary model bytes obtained, no checked local geometry, render, measured bounds, cross-organ registration or clinical review. All sources await identical quality gate.
Lung-male v1.4 exact VH_M_hyoid / UBERON:0001685 mapping unresolved. Do not change v1.4 pin or remove a row. v1.3 is an independent older-source candidate in its own audit directory only.
Separate hyoid anatomy source and mapping remain necessary; neither the v1.3 male lung nor the checked male larynx v1.0/v1.1 crosswalk lists the hyoid. No fabricated mesh or inferred alias.
Source-level candidate only; actual GLB bytes, strict parsing, node mapping, geometry, variant, fit and anatomical review remain unverified.

No dedicated whole-body skeletal-muscle source folder in this pinned HRA tree; existing BodyParts3D pilot maps eight named muscle-head/muscle concepts but is not exhaustive or female variant coverage. Require exact licensed muscle geometry/crosswalk and subsequent biomechanical review.

Pelvis source only; knees, intervertebral discs and selected female thoracic bones are separate folders not in this wave. BodyParts3D pilot six bone concepts remain a separate limited source candidate.
Only left kidney candidates in this wave; both right kidneys, renal pelvises, ureters, urinary bladder deferred. Kidney papilla CSV/metadata discrepancy remains.

Prostate and uterus are distinct source references, not equivalent sex variants of a complete system. Ovaries, tubes, testicular geometry and related structures require separate sources and laterality verification.
Pancreas geometry supplies macroscopic regions only. No thyroid, adrenal or pituitary-specific source folder in pinned tree; require independent verified sources and tissue/cell mapping.

Spleen references provide a partial named organ; thymus, lymph nodes and tonsils exist as separate pinned-tree candidate folders but are not inventoried by file in this wave. No lymphatic vessel network claim.
